results.name: Marketing
results.blurb: You sell the why-you'll-love-it. Ads, branding, social, and getting people to care. → Try DECA's marketing role-plays.

results.name: Finance
results.blurb: You make money grow and spot smart risks. Investing, markets, planning. → Business Finance; Stock Market Game.

results.name: Accounting
results.blurb: The truth-teller of business. Precise, trusted, detail-loving. → Accounting Applications.

results.name: Management / Business Administration
results.blurb: The one who runs the whole thing and keeps a team moving. → Principles of Business Management.

results.name: Entrepreneurship & Innovation
results.blurb: You build things that didn't exist yet and bet on your ideas. → Entrepreneurship events.

results.name: Hospitality & Tourism Management
results.blurb: You create experiences people remember — hotels, events, travel. → Hospitality role-plays.

results.name: Economics
results.blurb: You see the big invisible forces behind prices, choices, and markets. → Great base for finance + policy.

results.name: Business Analytics / Data
results.blurb: You find the story hidden in the numbers and predict what's next. → The future of every business.

results.name: Human Resources Management
results.blurb: You build great teams and keep workplaces fair and happy. → Human Resources Management event.

results.name: International Business
results.blurb: You do business across borders, languages, and cultures. → Perfect for global brands.

results.name: Supply Chain & Operations Management
results.blurb: You make the whole machine run — right thing, right place, fast and cheap. → The behind-the-scenes hero.

results.name: Management Information Systems (MIS)
results.blurb: You're the bridge between tech and business, solving problems with systems. → Business + coding.

results.name: Real Estate
results.blurb: You see value in property, location, and the deal. → Buying, selling, and building.

results.name: Sports & Entertainment Management
results.blurb: You love the game and the business behind it — teams, athletes, shows. → Sports & Entertainment Marketing.

results.name: 🏟️ Big Spirited State School
results.blurb: Huge, proud, buzzing with traditions. Vibe examples: Penn State, Indiana (Kelley), Michigan, Ohio State, UT–Austin.

results.name: 💼 Business Powerhouse
results.blurb: A famous, competitive program that opens serious doors. Vibe examples: UPenn (Wharton), NYU (Stern), Michigan (Ross), UVA (McIntire), UNC (Kenan-Flagler).

results.name: 🚀 Entrepreneurial / Startup Campus
results.blurb: Built for founders and makers. Vibe examples: Babson, MIT, Stanford, USC (Marshall).

results.name: 🌆 City Hustle School
results.blurb: In the middle of a real city, where class and career blur. Vibe examples: NYU, Fordham, Northeastern, Boston University.

results.name: 🤖 Tech-Meets-Business
results.blurb: Where business brains and builders collide. Vibe examples: Carnegie Mellon, Georgia Tech, Cornell, UC Berkeley (Haas).

results.name: 🌳 Close-Knit Community
results.blurb: Smaller, warmer, personal — professors know your name. Vibe examples: Bentley, Bryant, Villanova, Wake Forest.

results.name: 🌍 Global / Study-Abroad Campus
results.blurb: Languages, cultures, and a semester (or four) abroad. Vibe examples: Georgetown, American University, Middlebury, Boston University.

results.name: 🎭 Creative / Arts-Meets-Business
results.blurb: Where design, media, and entertainment meet the business side. Vibe examples: USC, NYU (Tisch + Stern), Emerson, The New School (Parsons).
